name: tack
description: A blazing-fast Firefox new tab page: one grid of the links you pin

scripts.lint: oxlint -c oxlintrc.json src scripts test && web-ext lint --source-dir src --self-hosted
scripts.sign: WEB_EXT_API_KEY=${WEB_EXT_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -s amo-jwt-issuer -w)} WEB_EXT_API_SECRET=${WEB_EXT_API_SECRET:-$(security find-generic-password -s amo-jwt-secret -w)} web-ext sign --source-dir src --channel unlisted
